__tool__.instructions: What is the person asking the smart home voice assistant to do?

criteria.lights: switch the lights on or off, change their brightness or colour
criteria.vacuum: start the robot vacuum or hoover cleaning the floors
criteria.coffee: make a cup of coffee with the coffee machine
criteria.plug: switch the smart plug or wemo socket on or off
criteria.speaker: change the speaker volume or mute it
criteria.no_call: something other than a home device function, such as a question or small talk

lights.action.instructions: Does the user want the lights switched on, switched off, made brighter, made dimmer or changed colour?

criteria.brighter: the lights made brighter, at a higher brightness
criteria.dimmer: the lights made dimmer, at a lower brightness
criteria.color: the lights changed to a particular colour

lights.room.instructions: Which room's lights does the user mean?

criteria.porch: the porch at the front door
criteria.all: the lights in every room of the house

lights.room?.instructions: Does the user say where the lights are, either a room such as the kitchen, the bedroom or the porch, or everywhere, such as all the lights or the whole home?

criteria.true: names a room, or asks for all the lights or the whole home
criteria.false: says nothing about a room or the whole home, only the lights

lights.color.instructions: Which colour does the user want the lights to be?

lights.color?.instructions: Does the user name a colour for the lights, such as red, blue or white?

vacuum.room.instructions: Which room does the user want vacuumed?

criteria.porch: the porch at the front door

vacuum.room?.instructions: Does the user say where to vacuum, either a room such as the kitchen, the bedroom or the hallway, or everywhere, such as the whole home?

criteria.true: names a room, or asks for the whole home or everywhere
criteria.false: says nothing about a room or the whole home, only to vacuum

coffee.drink.instructions: Which kind of coffee does the user want?

criteria.regular: a plain ordinary cup of coffee
criteria.espresso: a small strong shot of coffee
criteria.cappuccino: a coffee with a thick foamy milk top
criteria.latte: a mild milky coffee made with lots of steamed milk
criteria.americano: a long black coffee, a shot topped up with hot water

coffee.drink?.instructions: Does the user name a kind of coffee, such as an espresso, a latte or a cappuccino?

criteria.false: asks for coffee without saying which kind

plug.action.instructions: Does the user want the smart plug switched on or off?

criteria.on: the socket switched on, supplying power
criteria.off: the socket switched off, cutting the power

speaker.action.instructions: Does the user want the speaker louder, quieter or silenced?
